cohort: Women who underwent cesarean deliveries between January 2022 and January 2023 at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital, a tertiary care teaching hospital in New Delhi.
finding: The study found that Robson group I (21.95%) had the highest representation, followed by groups III (20.89%) and II (18.74%), while groups VIII (1.23%) and IX (0.32%) had the lowest representation, with group V contributing the most to the overall CS rate (12.42%).
